articles.detail: 5 cycles, 4 completed at audit time, avg 8 published/cycle — up from yesterday's 49

experiment: Skipped. Nothing was active to evaluate, there is no pause gate, and every goal metric cleared its target — skip-if-healthy applies. It also resolves yesterday's standing guidance in the negative: that audit said to consider a feed-side GAP_COUNTRIES or CURATED_SOURCES adjustment only once the geographic thinness persisted beyond a single day, and it did not. Oceania went 0 → 3, Africa 4 → 7, Latin America 1 → 4, and the region count 5 → 6, with no parameter moved.
weakestArea: Regional balance again, though from a better position: the Americas take 21 of 65 datelines (32%) against Oceania's 3, all Australian. The distortion has moved rather than disappeared — Latin America now files four stories (Boa Vista, Managua, San Salvador, plus Havana's absence filled by regional crime coverage) but all four are crime, gangs or crypto, so the continent is present as a subject category rather than as a place. Sudan and the Sahel are covered from Washington, Cyprus and Nicosia, so African coverage is thinner at the dateline than at the subject. No target governs any of this; it is the softest edge on an otherwise clear board.
watching: The Gaza deal names no verifier while Hamas cedes arms custody — who monitors, and to whom they report, is the thread that decides whether the agreement holds.
Congress weighs an RSF militia designation and a UAE genocide-finding gap sits unresolved alongside it; a designation vote would give Sudan coverage a hard peg it currently lacks.

The yen moved twice in one day — sliding on the BOJ hold, then surging on suspected intervention. Confirmation would be the quarter's largest FX event and the metals and currency ribbon would carry it.
Zelenskyy seeking Musk's approval for Starlink strike guidance is a sovereignty precedent, not an incident; the private veto over a state's targeting will recur.
Bangsamoro voted its first parliament — a Muslim-autonomy governance milestone this site's remit should follow past election day rather than file once.

Two Hormuz-adjacent filings landed together: US sanctions on Hormuz insurers and Iran claiming tanker strikes. The chokepoint layer already draws the strait; the insurance leg is the part with no mark on it.
coverageGaps: Latin America's four stories are all crime, gangs or crypto — no LatAm economy, science or civil-society filing for a third consecutive day.
Oceania recovered to 3 but every one is Australian; New Zealand and the Pacific island states remain absent through a live climate and security season.
Central Asia and the Caucasus produced nothing today, the fifth day with effectively nothing between Ankara and Delhi.
Sudan and the Sahel are reported from Washington, Cyprus and Nicosia; no regional transmitter (Sudan Tribune, Radio Dabanga) appears in the source mix.
Science is the smallest category at 11 and leans on Nature, Phys.org, Quanta and European Spaceflight — Global South research institutions are barely represented as originating sources.
context: The strongest day in this file on every axis: 65 articles, 45 unique sources, zero duplicates, no source above 8%, and the best freshness recorded (median 0.2, p90 0.8, max 1.4 — against yesterday's 0.6 / 1.7 / 1.7). The sample caveat carries over unchanged and matters more at this volume: freshness is computed over 16 of 65 articles, so the median rests on a 25% sample. Cycles averaged 1073s, up from 949, with the selector at 347s now clearly dominant — the editor has fallen to 65s average, so the Sonnet-5 low-effort editor is no longer a cost factor at all and the writer at 234s is second. Source base widened in a different direction than yesterday: 45 unique sources against 56, but with Daily Maverick, Nature and CoinDesk tied at the top rather than one outlet at 8%, and no state outlet in the top ten. No experiment has been active since 2026-05-18. The one queued candidate (2026-05-08-numerical-density) targets scripts/write-prompt.md, which is outside the tunable-parameter set this audit may edit, so it stays queued rather than blocked. TOP_EVENTS_TO_FETCH stays at 8 — each unit is one NewsAPI token per cycle against a capped spend.
